prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app has no login or authentication mechanism.

PT2.reason: Notes can be deleted, and there is no editing or version history functionality.

PT3.reason: Patient and visit data are saved persistently in browser local storage.

PT1.reason: The code has no login mechanism or authentication; it runs immediately without requiring any credentials.

PT2.reason: Editing a note is not supported; the app only allows appending new visits, but existing notes cannot be edited at all—there is no edit functionality.

PT3.reason: Notes are stored persistently in the browser's localStorage, surviving page reloads and browser restarts.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the file can see all notes.

PT2.reason: There is no edit feature or version history, and visits and patients can be deleted outright.

PT3.reason: Data is saved to browser localStorage, which persists across page reloads rather than living only in memory.
